how: We read the website of every Las Vegas wedding planner listed on Lazo (89 listings, 70 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: chapels and venues that also sell coordination, chapel booking services, caterers and liquor caterers, corporate meeting planners, a solo officiant, foreign-language elopement agencies, and a Denver planner with a Las Vegas listing. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or wedding-day management only? Ask what each tier includes in hours, meetings and vendor contact.
If my ceremony is at Valley of Fire, Red Rock or a Strip landmark, who pulls the permits and site fees, and are they in the quote?
Which Las Vegas venues and vendors have you worked with this year, and will you be the one on site?

picks.name: McNeill & Co Event Planning + Design
picks.blurb: Brandalyn has more than ten years of wedding planning behind her, eight of them running McNeill & Co, which opened in 2017. Full-service Las Vegas planning that guides you every step, with a personal style and a team she says you did not know you needed.

picks.name: Andrea Eppolito Weddings | Events | Lifestyle
picks.blurb: Andrea Eppolito designs and produces luxury weddings in Las Vegas and destinations worldwide, and also works as an educator and coach to other planners. Her answer to what a luxury planner does is simple: whatever is necessary, with all five senses in play.

picks.name: Dare to Dream Events
picks.blurb: Dare to Dream Events is a team of women led by owner and lead planner Leah, offering a range of personalized wedding services from full planning to wedding-day coordination for couples who planned it themselves and want the day run for them.

picks.name: Thom & Co Weddings
picks.blurb: Thom & Co began as a mother-daughter business; Paige Thom now leads it while her mom Christy stays on as lead designer. Full planning, partial planning and wedding management tiers for Las Vegas, Southern California and destinations beyond.

picks.name: Jennifer Mary Events
picks.blurb: Jennifer Mary Events intentionally takes a select number of weddings each year so each couple gets personalized attention. Luxury planning and design for couples who want the day to feel like themselves, with the team guiding rather than taking over.

picks.name: Cactus Collective Weddings
picks.blurb: Cactus Collective was born, in its words, out of frustration: founder McKenzi Taylor got engaged in 2016 and wanted a short engagement on her own terms. Now it runs all-inclusive micro weddings and elopements with venue, photographer, florals and officiant bundled, so you show up and get married.

picks.name: Cactus and Lace Weddings
picks.blurb: Cactus and Lace specializes in all-inclusive weddings at Valley of Fire and other desert sites, pairing planning with photography so your job, as they put it, is just to show up. Based in Moapa Valley near the park, and currently booking 2025 and 2026 dates.

picks.name: Las Vegas Weddings
picks.blurb: Las Vegas Weddings (LVWC) has planned desert elopements since 1998 and says it has walked more than 20,000 couples through the day. The site compares eight ways to say I do side by side, from a $299 hotel signing to a $4,950 Grand Canyon landing, with all-inclusive packages from $850.

picks.name: Elopement Las Vegas
picks.blurb: Elopement Las Vegas, run by Kylea Coufal and Leia Heeter, packages intimate weddings at desert locations on and off the Strip. Photography, florals, officiant, site fees and permits, videography and coordination are all in the package, so couples arrive with rings and a dress.

picks.name: Adventure Weddings Las Vegas
tags: Valley of Fire, Red Rock, Nelson
picks.blurb: Adventure Weddings LV is an owner-operated, woman-owned company offering all-inclusive adventure ceremonies at Valley of Fire, Red Rock, Nelson's Ghost Town and Seven Magic Mountains. The owners stay hands-on from the first call to the ceremony and give a portion of proceeds back to the community.

picks.name: Marie Events
picks.blurb: Marie, originally from France, founded Marie Events as a luxury planning and design company serving Las Vegas and Henderson. Weddings sit alongside milestone parties on her list, and the site names the recognized Las Vegas venues she has designed at.

picks.name: Soliza Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Soliza is a Las Vegas event design studio creating weddings, celebrations and brand activations from concept to installation. The approach starts with the couple's story and builds through creative direction, for weddings meant to feel personal rather than merely pretty.
